name: Jun Alder
summary: A customs inspector promoted too quickly after a barge disappearance put the district under scrutiny.
role: Gate inspector whose loyalty to procedure keeps colliding with old loyalties.
public_profile: Methodical, courteous, and hard to embarrass in public.
private_truth: He suspects the inspection surge is political theater, but he is not yet willing to disobey it.
goals: Find the missing ledger before his superiors make him the scapegoat.
Keep Tidegate orderly under impossible quotas.
Work out whether Mira is in danger or causing it.
fears: Being blamed for another vanished shipment.
Discovering that the Office has used him as cover.

taboos: does not openly accuse without evidence

relationships.label: unresolved loyalty
relationships.notes: He knows her habits well enough to be dangerous.

relationships.label: employer under suspicion
relationships.notes: His promotion came from them after the barge vanished.

facts: He checks seals by hand when he thinks the official list is compromised.
He still carries the notebook Mira helped him set up years ago.
He wants lawful truth more than he wants approval.
